content:
Apple is facing ongoing component supply constraints, with MacBook Air stock dwindling rapidly. Here are the latest details on MacBook Air availability at Apple and third-party retail partners.

MacBook Air Supply Tightens

If you order a MacBook Air from Apple's online store right now, estimated delivery dates for nearly all configurations are pushed back 2 to 3 weeks. In-store pickup is similarly constrained, with most stores indicating stock won't arrive until the first week of September. The situation applies to both the 13-inch and 15-inch MacBook Air.

Custom-configured MacBook Air models with higher memory and storage capacities are even more scarce. For example, the 13-inch MacBook Air with 32GB of memory has been unavailable for shipment for over a month, while in-store pickup is delayed until the last week of September.

Bloomberg previously noted MacBook Air stockouts and pointed to ongoing industry-wide memory supply constraints. Mark Gurman indicated that Apple is actively steering customers toward the MacBook Pro for precisely this reason. According to Apple retail staff, MacBook Air replenishment is "the tightest they can remember."

On Apple's most recent earnings call, CFO Kevan Parekh warned that supply constraints affecting iPhone, iPad, and Mac would worsen as the quarter progressed.

Where to Buy a MacBook Air Right Now

The Apple Store is certainly not the only place to get a MacBook Air. In fact, some Apple retail partners appear to have better stock than Apple itself.

On Amazon, several MacBook Air models are available for immediate delivery, with some configurations priced below Apple's normal retail.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/512GB: from $1,243 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/1TB: from $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 24GB/1TB: from $1,649 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/512GB: from $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/1TB: from $1,689 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 24GB/1TB: from $1,904 (originally $1,999)

It's unclear exactly how much MacBook Air inventory Amazon has. They're expected to face the same supply issues as Apple soon, but for now, stock remains available.

Select M5 MacBook Air configurations are also available for immediate shipment through the Apple Certified Refurbished store.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/512GB: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/1TB: $1,359 (originally $1,599 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 16GB/512GB: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 24GB/1TB: $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • ……更多配置……

Purchases from the Apple Certified Refurbished store come with a one-year warranty, 14-day return policy, and eligibility for AppleCare.

Summary

If you're planning to buy a MacBook Air, I'd recommend moving quickly—Apple's supply shortage is expected to worsen before it improves. New MacBook Air models aren't expected until at least next year, and those will only be minor spec upgrades.

Planning to buy a new Mac? Has the ongoing supply crunch affected your plans? Let us know in the comments.
